full_details: At gone nine, Burbage began the King's answer before Pope's Buckingham had landed the speech. You asked him to wait. He waited so largely that the pause was another way of commanding the stage. You had them try again without announcing it. For a moment the King heard something he did not expect. The empty yard changed more than it had under the louder reading. Before you left the house you wrote that a king who listens frights more than one who shouts, and that you are to use it. At home the Plutarch was on the shelf, unbound, and Daniel's third book was tomorrow's. The Holinshed was still out. In the afternoon you were in the bill of Richard III. The roll had the play and the hour. The three words stayed three words.
one_sentence: You asked Burbage to let Buckingham finish, wrote the note at the Theatre, and went on in the afternoon bill of Richard III.
title: Let Buckingham finish, then Richard III
